run_get_crowdhuman_id_hw: run the script to collect image height and width metas from CrowdHuman dataset using a config file
run_get_image_metas: run the get_image_metas function to extract image shape from a single CrowdHuman annotation JSON string
run_parse_args: run the parse_args function to parse command line arguments for config path dataset type and number of processes
review_get_image_metas: review the get_image_metas function that loads an image via mmcv and returns its ID mapped to height and width
refactor_main: refactor the main function to change how CrowdHuman image metas are collected and saved to JSON
